## Summary of Evaluation

**One conformance issue identified:**

| Selector | Rule | Severity | Description |
|----------|------|----------|-------------|
| `#cpf` | `ds-structure-input-tag` | Serious | The `<input>` element has the `br-input` class applied directly to it, but according to design system structure rules, the class should be applied to a parent `<div>` container that wraps both the `<label>` and the `<input>`. The container should have the `br-input` class, not the input element itself. |
